main_measure.name: in-stretch minus all-bar mean next-bar return (before costs)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: in-stretch mean > all-bar mean with one-sided t >= 2.0 and higher up-day share; reject: in-stretch mean <= all-bar mean or t <= -2.0; inconclusive: -2.0 < t < 2.0, fewer than 100 in-stretch bars or fewer than 3 up-cross stretches

supporting_check.name: in-stretch up-day share minus all-bar up-day share

decided_by: Inconclusive: the in-stretch mean exceeds the all-bar mean but the t-statistic lies between -2.0 and 2.0.
reading: Situation taken as the component's raw spread (last_history_value) above 0 with a positive forecast; in-stretch means forecast > 0, the all-bar group includes the in-stretch bars, an up day is a next-bar return above 0, and distinct up-cross stretches are counted as runs of consecutive forecast > 0 bars within each window (a run open at a window's first row counts as one).
